description: Synthetic STO roster CSV fixtures. No value is copied from the real corpus. Officer fields carry an OFFICER-CANARY token that must never appear outside these files.

fixtures.purpose: The 12-column normal header with unremarkable rows. Baseline happy path.
The 15-column officer header where every row carries the officer tail. The officer author and its date are unquoted.
A 15-column officer header where only some rows carry the officer tail. Omitted tails are a legitimate observed variant and must not shift columns or reject the file.
Embedded quotes and commas in Public Comment and Status, matching the corpus shapes that defeat both strict and permissive CSV parsing.
The same Character name and account handle appears twice in one export. The snapshot must not become effective and must not be map-overwritten.
Paired export taken in America/New_York. Filename stamp 01:13:38 local resolves to 2026-08-24T05:13:38Z.
Paired export taken in Europe/London four seconds later. Filename stamp 06:13:42 local resolves to 2026-08-24T05:13:42Z. Every row date must normalise to the same instant as its Eastern counterpart.
Earlier snapshot of a contribution reset pair. Cumulative total is high.
Later snapshot where the cumulative total drops to zero AND the join date changes. This is a rejoin discontinuity, never a negative donation.
Earlier snapshot of a Character rename candidate: same account handle, join date and Class; contribution differs, which does not disqualify it.
Later snapshot where the Character name changed but handle, join date and Class did not. A unique two-way match, so a rename PROPOSAL only.
Earlier snapshot of the account-rename shape: Character name, join date and Class are stable while the handle is about to change.
Later snapshot with a changed handle. A single corroborating alt is not enough to confirm; this must stay a proposal and must never rewrite an STO Info account handle.
A UTF-8 BOM prefix, which is explicitly allowed.
Fleet label ".Fixture Dotted Fleet." exercises punctuation that must survive exactly and must not be stripped, case-folded or slug-matched.
Fleet label "« Fixture Guillemet Fleet »" exercises punctuation that must survive exactly and must not be stripped, case-folded or slug-matched.
Fleet label "- Fixture Hyphen Fleet -" exercises punctuation that must survive exactly and must not be stripped, case-folded or slug-matched.
Fleet label "Fixture qa'Hom Fleet" exercises punctuation that must survive exactly and must not be stripped, case-folded or slug-matched.

An ambiguous tail. Under the 15-column header this row matches BOTH the officer-tail shape and the 12-column shape, so the tail boundary is not unique. It must be rejected with a row number and a safe code, never resolved by guessing.
Header is neither the normal nor the officer shape. Reject the file; do not fall back to permissive parsing.
A manually renamed export. The filename contract is anchored at both ends, so this is rejected. No suffix stripping is permitted.
A row date that does not exist in America/New_York because the clock jumps 2am to 3am on 10 March 2024. Must be rejected explicitly, not silently shifted.
